title: hesperis incana
intro: Hesperis incana, commonly known as Dune Larkspur or Prickly Geranium, is a perennial plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, making it a valuable addition to traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Hesperis incana are attributed to its ability to act as a vasodilator, improving blood flow and reducing blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
